sources.title: Fine-tune Gemma in Keras using LoRA | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: This technique makes training with LoRA much faster and more memory-efficient, and produces smaller model weights (a few hundred MBs), all while maintaining the quality of the model outputs. This tutorial walks you through using Keras to perform LoRA fine-tuning on a Gemma model. Setup

sources.snippet: LoRA (Finetuning) # This is an example on fine-tuning Gemma with LoRA. It’s best to first read the finetuning colab to understand this one. See the LoRA sampling tutorial if you just want to do inference with LoRA.
